Thanks Susan — appreciate the clarity on what procurement needs.

Attached is a first-pass "procurement trigger matrix" (commit_trigger_matrix_v1.xlsx) plus a draft SOW skeleton (SOW_clearpath_draft.pdf). High level notes:

- Dedicated: recommended for customers who commit to sustained token volumes > 45M tokens/month or concurrency > 200 p50. Reserved GPU pool options (~NVIDIA H100x2-equivalent slots) scale starting at 4-node commitments.
- Private: recommended when ClearPath requires complete control over network ingress/egress, or firm air-gap/on-prem constraints; typical procurement path includes a 6-10 week delivery for on-prem appliances + security review.
- Hybrid path: start with Dedicated pilot (8 weeks, 4-GPU reserved pool) to validate latency & cost; if audit/regulatory gates require, transition to Private with a migration TAP and migration credits baked into SOW.

1) Andre: confirm target 12-month forecast (monthly token profile + peak concurrency).
2) Susan: indicate whether SOC 2 + penetration test attestation is sufficient vs. an on-site audit requirement.
3) Redwood (Lauren/Marissa): please confirm GPU family recommendations and pricing bands for the tiers in the attached matrix.

I'll follow up Monday morning with updated numbers once we have your forecast.

Adding compute and procurement specifics below (see inline).

On Sat, Aug 22, 2026 at 1:45 PM priyom.das@redwood.com wrote:
> - Dedicated: recommended for customers who commit to sustained token volumes > 45M tokens/month or concurrency > 200 p50. Reserved GPU pool options (~NVIDIA H100x2-equivalent slots) scale starting at 4-node commitments.

Quick refinement: the thresholds should be expressed as both token/month + steady-state concurrent streams at 8k context to capture memory/KV cache needs. Revised guidance:
- Entry Dedicated Tier: 4 x H100-80GB nodes (baseline) — right for ~30–60M tokens/month with sustained concurrency up to 180 streams at typical 1–2 prompt/response lengths.
- Growth Dedicated Tier: 12 x H100-80GB nodes — supports ~180M tokens/month and burst concurrency up to 600.
- Private Appliance (on-prem): recommended when SLO requires sub-15ms per-token latencies on private network for certain inference paths OR when legal requires data residency with no cloud egress. Delivery lead times: 8–12 weeks for VPC-managed Private, 10–14 weeks for full on-prem shipping (hardware procurement + security baseline).

Pricing bands (ballpark):
- Dedicated entry (4 nodes reserved): list-price committed discount: $65–75k/month (depends on reserved term and QPS profile).
- Dedicated growth (12 nodes): $180–210k/month.
- Private on-prem baseline: one-time platform fee $350k + monthly support & managed control plane $25k/month + optional reserved capacity pricing if we co-manage GPUs.

Procurement triggers (recommended matrix rows):
- Forecasted 3-mo average tokens/month > 30M -> start dedicated pilot (4 nodes)
- Forecasted 6-mo moving average > 75M -> convert to committed 12-node Dedicated Tier
- Security/procurement requires custom KMS/HSM or no-cloud-egress -> move to Private evaluation and procurement track (SOW includes migration credits).

I'll update the spreadsheet with these numbers and include a quick glossary (tokens, p50 concurrency, node equivalence).

—Lauren
Principal Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

Andre — quick answers inline and next steps below.

1) Scale lead time: we can scale Dedicated from 4 -> 12 nodes typically within 10 business days when capacity is in-region and not at peak; if cross-region or during high demand windows, allow up to 4 weeks. We do run a prioritized ramp queue for committed customers.

2) Private installation estimates: will provide a simple cost range in the final SOW — typical on-prem installation & travel + rack/cabling estimate is $40–65k depending on site readiness. We'll attach a short site-prep checklist.

Ramp discount: we can offer a 25–30% one-time conversion credit (applied to first 3 months) when pilot spend converts to a 12-month committed Dedicated contract — we will put the exact % into the SOW.

DRA / SLA notes: Dedicated SLA includes monthly uptime target 99.9% and documented operational fallback to adjacent region with best-effort performance — full DR playbook provided in the procurement appendix. Private deployments have separate SLA language in the Private Addendum.

Next steps:
- Redwood to submit updated matrix (final) and SOW with the ramp credit and site-prep checklist by Thu EOD 27 Aug.
- ClearPath to send 12-month token forecast CSV by Wed 26 Aug.

I'll slot a 30-minute procurement review on Thu after we send the updated doc.

Thanks — looking forward.

Priyom
